description:
Erection of new internally illuminated signs.
SIGN 01, 02 & 03: New Aldi Logo Sign
SIGN 04: Welcome Vinyl on Glazing 
SIGN 05: Aldi Logo Vinyl on Glazing 
SIGN 06: Shared Double Sided Totem, Supporting Signs 6A and 6B
SIGN 06A: Aldi Logo Sign
SIGN 06B: Unit 2 Logo Sign- Details to be agreed as part of a separate application.
SIGN07: Aldi Double-Sided Totem  Supporting Signs 7A and 7B
SIGN07A: Aldi Logo Sign
SIGN07B: Aldi Opening Hours Sign
SIGN 08: Unit 2 Double-Sided Totem Supporting Signs 8A and 8B. Details to be agreed as part of a separate application.
SIGN 08A: Unit 2 Logo Sign Details to be agreed as part of a separate application.
SIGN 08B: Unit 2 Opening Hours Sign Details to be agreed as part of a separate application.
SIGN 09: Car Park Entry 
SIGN 10: Pedestrian Sign Entry 
SIGN 11: Service Yard Entry Sign
SIGNS 12-15  Images with Aldi Logo on Vinyl
SIGN 16  Aldi Sign - Individual White Polished Acrylic Letters
decision_conditions:
The intensity of all sign illumination shall not exceed 33 candelas per square metre, with the exception of Sign 16 letters which shall not exceed 114 candelas per square metre.
REASON: To preserve amenity and prevent danger to road users.
